## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Graph interfaces
//
// The shared interface of every graph-shaped type: how many vertices and edges
// it has, and whether its edges are directed. Vertices are the zero-based
// integers 0 through VertexCount - 1.

// The family of graph-shaped types: a vertex count, an edge count, and a
// directedness flag. Vertices are the integers 0 through VertexCount - 1.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Graph_(discrete_mathematics))
interface IGraph
    inherits IValue
{
    VertexCount(x: Self): Integer;
    EdgeCount(x: Self): Integer;
    IsDirected(x: Self): Boolean;
}
```
